newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Irish Life rating at AA minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Irish Life rating at AA minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it affirmed the financial strength rating of Irish Life Assurance Plc (ILA) at AA minus.

The agency also said in a statement that the claims paying ability ratings of the company's U.S. subsidiaries InterState Assurance and First Variable Life, being based on a gurantee from ILA, were also affirmed at AA minus.

"The rating reflects ILA's excellent capitalisation and financial flexibility, strong bottom-line earnings and a business position which, despite some erosion into domestic market is still very good," S&P said.
"An offsetting factor is ILA's relatively lacklustre operating efficiency, making the Irish business vulnerable to any increase in competition and/or regulatory focus," it said.
"Standard & Poor's expectation of sustained improvements in this area is a key factor supporting the current rating," it said.
